title: Tribute Summon L5-2
source: Port-authored setup from Tools/puzzles/generate_puzzles.py template 'tribute_summon', level 5, variant 2. The line uses engine-supported cards but is not a GBA fixed-board reconstruction.
notes: Tribute Mystical Elf, La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp for Blue-Eyes White Dragon, then attack for exactly 5500.

canon_reference.setup_status: canon setup unavailable; this file uses a port-authored template
solution_steps: Use Premature Burial to revive Exiled Force.
Use Exile's effect to destroy Giant Germ.
Return Marauding Captain to your hand using The Warrior Returning Alive.
Summon Marauding Captain and then, using his effect, Mataza the Zapper.
Equip Mataza with Axe of Despair.
Attack the face-down Giant Axe Mummy with Mataza, then attack directly for game.
